extension.summary: Resonance: a minimal Spotify music browser and player for Kodi
Spotify-Premium-Musik in Kodi hören: Resonance-Plugin (Spotty/librespot), getestet auf LibreELEC/Raspberry Pi
extension.description: Resonance is a lightweight Spotify music browser for Kodi focused on playlists, search, albums, artists and playback. It uses the regular Spotify Web API catalogue with persistent caching and shared rate-limit handling. Spotify Premium is required. Podcasts, audiobooks, lyrics and library editing are not included.

Resonance ist ein leichtgewichtiges Spotify-Musik-Add-on für Kodi mit Playlists, Suche, Alben, Künstlern und Wiedergabe. Es verwendet die reguläre Spotify Web API mit persistentem Cache und gemeinsamer Rate-Limit-Behandlung. Spotify Premium ist erforderlich.
extension.disclaimer: This product uses the SPOTIFY WEB API but is not endorsed, certified or otherwise approved in any way by Spotify. Spotify is the registered trademark of Spotify AB.
Dieses Produkt verwendet die SPOTIFY WEB API, wird jedoch in keiner Weise von Spotify unterstützt, zertifiziert oder anderweitig genehmigt. Spotify ist eine eingetragene Marke von Spotify AB.
extension.news: [B]1.0.0[/B] - Version 1 release of Resonance for Kodi. - Spotify Web API-only catalogue: search, playlists, albums, artists, links and track metadata use the browser PKCE token. - Two independent sign-ins: Device Connect (Spotty) for playback, and browser PKCE sign-in for the catalogue. - Hosted callback relay for the browser sign-in (https://resonance-spotify-callback.vercel.app/api/callback) with paste-code fallback; configurable Client ID and redirect URI in Settings. - Persistent catalogue cache, loopback audio streaming service and shared provider rate-limit/cooldown handling. - Tested on LibreELEC on Raspberry Pi (incl. Pi 5) with Kodi 20/21/22.
